brief: A small station where the last train never arrives.

candidates.premise: The station keeps publishing arrivals for a town it owes years of missed service.
candidates.deviation: The timetable is a municipal debt ledger.
candidates.scene_engine: Clerks barter corrections while passengers contest who is owed a train.
candidates.recurring_pressure: The board adds one overdue household each night.
candidates.world_motion: The council edits the ledger before the weekly audit.

candidates.premise: Three families legally live on one platform until service resumes.
candidates.deviation: Rail law turns the platform into protected housing.
candidates.scene_engine: Meals, inspections, visitors, and privacy disputes collide with station operations.
candidates.recurring_pressure: A housing inspector arrives every third morning.
candidates.world_motion: Families negotiate rooms and challenge eviction notices without the user.

candidates.premise: A signal box receives mundane calls from trains scheduled decades later.
candidates.deviation: Future callers mainly report ordinary maintenance failures.
candidates.scene_engine: Operators decide which small warnings to act on without revealing the line.
candidates.recurring_pressure: Each prevented failure changes who calls next.
candidates.world_motion: Rail management traces unauthorized repairs and rotates staff.
